description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kudamake, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District (25/5514139)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Land No. 109 and Land No. 113) with detailed ownership information, property boundaries, and legal encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration, cadastral mapping, and title settlement - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
